summary: Recent updates to the Firefox documentation have improved its clarity and consistency by converting the graphics-related documentation from ReStructuredText (RST) into Markdown, a simpler and more widely-used format for writing documentation. This change not only helps in maintaining the documents more efficiently but also addresses specific warnings from the markdown linter, ensuring that the content adheres to better formatting standards. These updates are significant as they enhance readability and accessibility for developers and users alike, making it easier to find and use important graphics-related information in Firefox.
